classification: paper design; no new-domain implementation or experimental result

identity_rules.collision: same ID/different identity or payload fails
identity_rules.unknown_time: explicit unknown reason; never ingest-time replacement
identity_rules.ris: artifact SHA256 + decompressed header offset + expansion ordinal + scope + counting policy; proposed, Phase16 proof required
identity_rules.rpki: membership scope+ASN+canonical prefix+maxLength; observation descriptor distinct
identity_rules.dns: raw Parquet row-group/row occurrence; groups bind partition and comparison policy
identity_rules.terraform: existing snapshot ID and repository/path-incarnation/commit/ordinal sidecar unchanged

completion_rules.rpki: independent descriptor; complete comparable consecutive states only
completion_rules.dns: complete partition does not imply observed entity absence; no inferred empty result
completion_rules.ris: framed accepted subset and error ledger; no full route-state claim

parser_risk.offset_status: feasible from inspected framing; not locally proved
parser_risk.fallback: all-record index including errors; must amend freeze and verify mapping
